The [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] '''Personal Luxury Yacht 3000''' was a [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] starship, similar to a [[Transport/Legends|transport]], only more suited to travellers rather than cargo, and far more luxurious.

==Characteristics==
[[File:LadyLuck_egvv.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 schematics]]
The Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 was 50 meters long, with a pair of engine pods that extended from the main hull. Each pod housed a [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] engine and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engine. It also had an observational level with an exterior deck near the aft of the ship, while the interior compartment had a small jet-stream meditation pool and several conform-couches. The main deck offered a dining area, a large private suite, and five visitor cabins, as well as the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], the bridge and the main control systems. In addition, the viewports on the side of the ship were retractable. Above the bridge was a docking coupling. It also housed a retractable laser cannon on the ventral side of the ship in the event of emergencies. It sometimes also utilized [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]]. The power couplings and sensor arrays were at the front of the ship, and in some cases jutted out.

==History==
<div style="float:right;">[[File:SoroSuub3000LuxuryYacht-SWE.jpg|thumb|220px|A Personal Luxury Yacht 3000 during the Clone Wars]]</div>
The Personal Luxury Yacht 3000s, made by SoroSuub, were utilized as early as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], including a visit to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

During the [[Liberation of Gerrard V]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the planet's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] governor used a small fleet of these yachts in an attempt to pillage the planet's priceless treasures and military supplies as he fled; this was thwarted by [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron's]] use of ion cannons. A single yacht was also seen during [[Rogue Squadron]]'s [[Battle above Taloraan|raid on Taloraan]].

The pirate [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] owned a Personal Luxury Yacht 3000, known as ''[[Fortune and Glory/Legends|Fortune and Glory]]'', which he used several times during the Clone Wars.

A [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Personal Luxury Yacht 3000|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]] was purchased by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], disguised as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], from a [[Unidentified Bith starship dealer|Bith starship dealer]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] was purchased as part of an undercover mission to uncover a [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine/Legends|kidnapping plot]] spearheaded by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]]. [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] later used this ship, piloted by a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] named [[Ttekket]] during a [[Raid on the Descent Shopping Mall]].

This type of ship was later used by members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], namely [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], owner of the [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']], and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], owner of the ''[[Jade's Fire]]''.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
There is an error in the ship's depiction in the ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' TV series. In the show the ship is shown to fire lasers out of the two antenna-like structures on the ventral side of the vessel. However, ''The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels'' identifies these structures as the comm transceiver.
